title: Zep Tepi and the Canyon
subtitle: Test your understanding of Zep Tepi and the Canyon — the First Time headquarters in the Grand Canyon, the North Rim names, and the later river-city trail.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Zep Tepi can be read as a headquarters and a naming trail, with the canyon landforms on one side and the later river cities on the other. The same account sets the 1909 underground-city report beside the removal of giant remains. The place, the name, and the hidden evidence belong in one picture.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Zep Tepi and the Canyon deep-dive

questions.question: Where were the primary Anuk headquarters during Zep Tepi?

options.label: A
options.text: Within Thebes on the Mississippi River trade corridor
options.rationale: Thebes, Illinois is a post-reset town, and the headquarters were within the Grand Canyon.

options.label: B
options.text: Within the vaults holding confiscated giant human remains
options.rationale: The vaults stored later finds, and the headquarters were within the Grand Canyon.

options.label: C
options.text: Within Cairo where the Ohio meets the Mississippi River
options.rationale: Cairo, Illinois is a later river town, and the headquarters stood within the Grand Canyon.

options.label: D
options.text: Within the Grand Canyon in North America as the command base
options.rationale: During this period the primary Anuk headquarters were established within the Grand Canyon in North America.

questions.hint: The overview places the command center on one continent.

questions.question: Which window in the reset sequence matches the epoch of Zep Tepi?

options.label: A
options.text: During the April 1909 report
options.rationale: April 1909 is the date of the Arizona Gazette city report, not the epoch of Zep Tepi.

options.label: B
options.text: During Reset 1 or Reset 2
options.rationale: The historical epoch known as Zep Tepi corresponds directly to Reset 1 or Reset 2.

options.label: C
options.text: During the 1819 Memphis year
options.rationale: 1819 is the founding year of Memphis, Tennessee, not the epoch of Zep Tepi.

options.label: D
options.text: During the 1880s Dutton work
options.rationale: The 1880s credit belongs to Clarence Dutton, not to the epoch of Zep Tepi.

questions.hint: The opening line ties this epoch to early numbered resets.

questions.question: Where did the names later tied to ancient Egypt first arise?

options.label: A
options.text: At the Grand Canyon command post during the First Time
options.rationale: The Anuk generated the original nomenclature at the Grand Canyon command post.

options.label: B
options.text: At the restricted vaults after the railroad mound cuts
options.rationale: The vaults held later remains, and the names began at the Grand Canyon command post.

options.label: C
options.text: At the Ohio and Mississippi river confluence
options.rationale: That confluence is the site of Cairo, Illinois, not the start of the original names.

options.label: D
options.text: At the 1819 Memphis landing on the Mississippi
options.rationale: Memphis is a later river city, and the names began at the Grand Canyon command post.

questions.hint: Terminology names the post where the original names began.

questions.question: Which two waterways center the North Rim naming trail?

options.label: A
options.text: 94-Mile Creek and Trinity Creek beside the North Rim cluster
options.rationale: The landforms are centered primarily around 94-Mile Creek and Trinity Creek.

options.label: B
options.text: The Ohio and Mississippi confluence beside a river town
options.rationale: That confluence marks Cairo, Illinois, not the center of the North Rim cluster.

options.label: C
options.text: The April 1909 report beside the Arizona Gazette page
options.rationale: The Gazette page is a 1909 news report, not the pair of creeks at the cluster.

options.label: D
options.text: The 1819 Memphis landing beside the ancient capital name
options.rationale: Memphis was founded in 1819 on the Mississippi, far from the two canyon creeks.

questions.hint: The North Rim section names two creeks at the center of the cluster.

questions.question: Which North Rim formation is linked to the look of the Great Pyramid?

options.label: A
options.text: The nearby Tower of Set peak
options.rationale: Tower of Set is a key landform in the cluster, not the formation likened to the Great Pyramid.

options.label: B
options.text: The Cheops Pyramid formation
options.rationale: Cheops Pyramid is designated for its direct visual and geometric resemblance to the Great Pyramid.

options.label: C
options.text: The Isis Temple butte face
options.rationale: Isis Temple is a massive, prominent butte, not the formation likened to the Great Pyramid.

options.label: D
options.text: The major Osiris Temple peak
options.rationale: Osiris Temple is a major peak in the deity sequence, not the formation likened to the Great Pyramid.

questions.hint: One formation in the naming sequence is compared with that pyramid.

questions.question: Whom does official history credit for assigning the North Rim names?

options.label: A
options.text: Geologist Clarence Dutton in the 1880s
options.rationale: Official history attributes the naming convention to geologist Clarence Dutton in the 1880s.

options.label: B
options.text: The Smithsonian Institution after 1909
options.rationale: The Smithsonian dismissed the 1909 city report, and the naming credit is given to Clarence Dutton.

options.label: C
options.text: The Arizona Gazette in April 1909
options.rationale: The Gazette reported an underground city, and the naming credit is given to Clarence Dutton.

options.label: D
options.text: Railroad crews cutting burial mounds
options.rationale: Railroad crews uncovered skeletons, and the naming credit is given to Clarence Dutton.

questions.hint: The North Rim section names the person official history credits.

questions.question: Which post-reset city sits where the Ohio meets the Mississippi?

options.label: A
options.text: Thebes, Illinois, on the trade corridor
options.rationale: Thebes lies on the Mississippi trade corridor, not at the Ohio confluence.

options.label: B
options.text: Cairo, Illinois, at the river junction
options.rationale: Cairo, Illinois is located at the confluence of the Ohio and Mississippi Rivers.

options.label: C
options.text: Karnak, Illinois, after the temple complex
options.rationale: Karnak was named after the ancient temple complex, not placed at the Ohio confluence.

options.label: D
options.text: Memphis, Tennessee, founded in 1819
options.rationale: Memphis was founded in 1819 along the Mississippi, not at the Ohio confluence.

questions.hint: One Illinois town is placed at a meeting of two rivers.

questions.question: When was Memphis, Tennessee set along the Mississippi?

options.label: A
options.text: In 1819 along the Mississippi and named after the ancient capital
options.rationale: Memphis, Tennessee was founded in 1819 along the Mississippi River and named after the ancient capital.

options.label: B
options.text: During Reset 1 beside the Grand Canyon command post site
options.rationale: Reset 1 is the epoch of the canyon headquarters, not the founding year of Memphis.

options.label: C
options.text: In April 1909 as a front-page note in the Arizona Gazette
options.rationale: April 1909 is the Gazette report of an underground city, not the founding of Memphis.

options.label: D
options.text: In the 1880s by Clarence Dutton across the North Rim rocks
options.rationale: The 1880s credit belongs to Clarence Dutton on the North Rim, not to the founding of Memphis.

questions.hint: The river-city section gives a founding year for one Tennessee town.

questions.question: Which towns belong to the Little Egypt regional network?

options.label: A
options.text: The names Ra, Set, and Cheops
options.rationale: Ra, Set, and Cheops are canyon landforms, not towns in the Illinois network.

options.label: B
options.text: Dongola, Carmi, and Goshen
options.rationale: The Little Egypt regional network include Dongola, Illinois, Carmi, Illinois, and Goshen, Illinois.

options.label: C
options.text: Isis, Horus, and Osiris town
options.rationale: Isis, Horus, and Osiris are North Rim landforms, not towns in the Illinois network.

options.label: D
options.text: Cairo, Memphis, and Thebes city
options.rationale: Cairo, Memphis, and Thebes are named in the main river trail, apart from that smaller Illinois list.

questions.hint: The river-city section lists a smaller Illinois network.

questions.question: Which outlet carried the April 1909 report of a subterranean city in the canyon?

options.label: A
options.text: The Arizona Gazette article
options.rationale: In April 1909 the Arizona Gazette detailed the discovery of a subterranean underground city.

options.label: B
options.text: The Smithsonian vault note
options.rationale: The Smithsonian dismissed the article, and the Arizona Gazette detailed the discovery.

options.label: C
options.text: The Clarence Dutton field note
options.rationale: Clarence Dutton is tied to the 1880s naming credit, not to the 1909 city report.

options.label: D
options.text: The railroad burial mound note
options.rationale: Railroad work uncovered skeletons, and the Arizona Gazette detailed the city discovery.

questions.hint: The 1909 section names the paper that carried the city report.

questions.question: What does this account tie to the founding of the Smithsonian Institution?

options.label: A
options.text: Arizona Gazette ownership
options.rationale: The Gazette reported the 1909 city, and the founding is under Freemasonic direction.

options.label: B
options.text: Railroad expansion funding
options.rationale: Railroad expansion uncovered skeletons, and the founding is under Freemasonic direction.

options.label: C
options.text: Freemasonic direction
options.rationale: The Smithsonian Institution is an entity established under Freemasonic direction.

options.label: D
options.text: Anuk command post orders
options.rationale: The Anuk command post belongs to the First Time, and the founding is under Freemasonic direction.

questions.hint: The Smithsonian terminology line names the direction behind its founding.

questions.question: What activity uncovered giant human skeletons across the continent?

options.label: A
options.text: Railroad expansion cutting through burial mounds and hills
options.rationale: Railroad expansion cut through burial mounds and hills and uncovered giant human skeletons.

options.label: B
options.text: City founding at Cairo, Memphis, Thebes, and Karnak
options.rationale: Those cities repeat the naming trail, and the skeletons were uncovered by railroad cuts.

options.label: C
options.text: Geological naming along 94-Mile Creek and Trinity Creek
options.rationale: Those creeks center the North Rim names, and the skeletons were uncovered by railroad cuts.

options.label: D
options.text: A front-page story in the Arizona Gazette in April 1909
options.rationale: The Gazette reported an underground city, and the skeletons were uncovered by railroad cuts.

questions.hint: The suppression section names the work that cut through mounds.

questions.question: What height range is recorded for those skeletons?

options.label: A
options.text: A span from 12 feet tall to over 35 meters
options.rationale: Workers uncovered Giant human skeletons ranging from 12 feet tall to over 35 meters in height.

options.label: B
options.text: A span from 94-Mile Creek to Trinity Creek
options.rationale: Those creeks locate the naming cluster, and the skeletons range from 12 feet to over 35 meters.

options.label: C
options.text: A span from the 1819 founding to the 1909 report
options.rationale: 1819 and 1909 are a founding year and a news date, not the height range of the skeletons.

options.label: D
options.text: A span from Cairo, Illinois to Karnak, Illinois
options.rationale: Those towns are on the later naming trail, not the height range of the skeletons.

questions.hint: The suppression section gives a height range for the skeletons.

questions.question: How many giant specimens were moved into restricted storage?

options.label: A
options.text: The April 1909 Gazette article on the city
options.rationale: That article is one news report, and the vault count is over 10,000 specimens.

options.label: B
options.text: Over 10,000 specimens placed in the vaults
options.rationale: The Smithsonian transferred over 10,000 giant specimens into restricted underground vaults.

options.label: C
options.text: The 1880s Dutton note on the North Rim
options.rationale: The 1880s note is the official naming credit, and the vault count is over 10,000 specimens.

options.label: D
options.text: The 1819 Memphis record along the river
options.rationale: 1819 dates the founding of Memphis, and the vault count is over 10,000 specimens.

questions.hint: The suppression section gives a count of specimens moved into storage.

questions.question: Why was the subterranean canyon discovery called a hoax?

options.label: A
options.text: To guard the named rock formations along Trinity Creek
options.rationale: Trinity Creek centers the naming cluster, and the hoax label was meant to suppress physical evidence.

options.label: B
options.text: To archive the Arizona Gazette page from April 1909
options.rationale: The Gazette published the city report, and the hoax label was meant to suppress physical evidence.

options.label: C
options.text: To suppress physical evidence of earlier infrastructure
options.rationale: The dismissal was meant to suppress physical evidence of pre-reset civilizational infrastructure.

options.label: D
options.text: To credit geologist Clarence Dutton with the North Rim names
options.rationale: Dutton is the official naming credit, and the hoax label was meant to suppress physical evidence.

questions.hint: Read why the underground-city report was dismissed.

questions.question: Which pair stands together in the North Rim deity cluster?

options.label: A
options.text: The Tower of Ra and the Tower of Set in that cluster
options.rationale: Tower of Ra and Tower of Set are recorded within the same geographic cluster.

options.label: B
options.text: Cairo, Illinois and Karnak, Illinois on the rivers
options.rationale: Cairo and Karnak are later river towns, and the tower pair is Ra and Set.

options.label: C
options.text: The Horus Temple and the Osiris Temple nearby
options.rationale: Horus Temple and Osiris Temple are in the sequence, and the tower pair is Ra and Set.

options.label: D
options.text: The Isis Temple and the Cheops Pyramid on the rim
options.rationale: Isis Temple and Cheops Pyramid are in the sequence, and the tower pair is Ra and Set.

questions.hint: Two tower names sit in the same canyon cluster.

questions.question: What role did Thebes, Illinois have on the later naming trail?

options.label: A
options.text: The Anuk command post of Reset 1 or Reset 2
options.rationale: The command post was in the Grand Canyon, and Thebes is a stop on the trade corridor.

options.label: B
options.text: The newsroom behind the April 1909 Gazette
options.rationale: The Gazette is an Arizona paper, and Thebes is a stop on the trade corridor.

options.label: C
options.text: A vault holding confiscated giant human remains
options.rationale: The giant remains went into Smithsonian vaults, and Thebes is a stop on the trade corridor.

options.label: D
options.text: A stop on the Mississippi River trade corridor
options.rationale: Thebes, Illinois was established directly along the Mississippi River trade corridor.

questions.hint: One Illinois town is placed on a river trade corridor.

questions.question: Where does standard historical framing place the First Time?

options.label: A
options.text: From the Grand Canyon rim
options.rationale: The canyon is the operational seat in this account, and standard framing places the origin in North Africa.

options.label: B
options.text: From the Smithsonian vaults
options.rationale: The vaults held later remains, and standard framing places the origin in North Africa.

options.label: C
options.text: From the Mississippi bank
options.rationale: The Mississippi towns are a later trail, and standard framing places the origin in North Africa.

options.label: D
options.text: From North Africa, Egypt
options.rationale: Standard framing places the origin in North Africa, while the operational seat was on the North American continent.

questions.hint: Core revelations contrast two continents.

questions.question: What did the later river cities do with the original Anuk pattern?

options.label: A
options.text: They replaced the 1909 Gazette with a new date
options.rationale: The Gazette is a 1909 paper, and the cities mirrored the original Anuk naming trail.

options.label: B
options.text: They mirrored the original Anuk naming trail
options.rationale: Later cities were established to mirror the original Anuk naming trail.

options.label: C
options.text: They left giant skeletons on open display
options.rationale: Giant remains were removed into vaults, and the cities mirrored the original Anuk naming trail.

options.label: D
options.text: They moved the command post to Memphis in 1819
options.rationale: The command post stayed in the canyon story, and the cities mirrored the original Anuk naming trail.

questions.hint: Terminology describes what later cities did with the older names.

questions.question: Recognizing the canyon headquarters changes the reading of which field?

options.label: A
options.text: Railroad cuts through burial mounds
options.rationale: Those cuts uncovered skeletons, and the changed field is global geography and ancient history.

options.label: B
options.text: Global geography and ancient history
options.rationale: Recognizing the canyon headquarters alters the understanding of global geography and ancient history.

options.label: C
options.text: The naming work of Clarence Dutton
options.rationale: Dutton is the official naming credit, and the changed field is global geography and ancient history.

options.label: D
options.text: The April 1909 Arizona Gazette story
options.rationale: The Gazette story is one dismissal case, and the changed field is global geography and ancient history.

questions.hint: Strategic implications names the field this recognition changes.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT one of the North Rim formations in the naming sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: Isis Temple, a massive prominent canyon butte
options.rationale: Isis Temple is a massive, prominent butte within the canyon system, so it belongs to the naming sequence.

options.label: B
options.text: Cheops Pyramid, formed like the Great Pyramid stone
options.rationale: Cheops Pyramid is in the naming sequence for its resemblance to the Great Pyramid.

options.label: C
options.text: Horus Temple, a rock formation beside Isis Temple
options.rationale: Horus Temple is a rock formation situated adjacent to the Isis Temple, so it belongs to the naming sequence.

options.label: D
options.text: Karnak, named after the ancient temple complex
options.rationale: Karnak, Illinois was named directly after the ancient temple complex, and it is a river town rather than a North Rim formation.

questions.hint: Three lines are canyon landforms and one is a later town.

questions.question: True or False: Zep Tepi is the foundational operational phase before later resets reconfigured continental geography.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Zep Tepi represents the foundational operational phase before subsequent civilizational resets reconfigured continental geography.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Zep Tepi is that early operational phase, and later resets are what reconfigured continental geography.

questions.hint: Broader context places this epoch before later geographic changes.

questions.question: True or False: Clarence Dutton created the original Anuk headquarters in the 1880s.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The 1880s credit assigns names, and the headquarters is the older canyon footprint.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The names are the surviving geographic footprint of the original Anuk headquarters, and the 1880s credit does not create that base.

questions.hint: The North Rim section says what the 1880s credit does and does not create.

questions.question: True or False: Horus Temple is a rock formation situated next to the Isis Temple.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Horus Temple is a prominent rock formation situated adjacent to the Isis Temple.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Horus Temple is the formation situated adjacent to the Isis Temple.

questions.hint: One temple line names the formation beside Isis.

questions.question: True or False: The Arizona Gazette declared the 1909 underground city a hoax.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The Gazette carried the city report, and other bodies are the ones who called it a hoax.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Official organizations and the Smithsonian rapidly declared the article a hoax, after the Arizona Gazette had reported the city.

questions.hint: The 1909 section separates the paper that reported the city from the body that dismissed it.
